faq.label: FAQ
faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about MarketRisk

q1.question: What data sources does MarketRisk use?
q1.answer: We monitor ANAF (tax authority), insolvency procedures (BPI), court cases (Dosare) and other official Romanian registers. All data is updated in real-time.

q2.question: Are there limits on how many companies I can monitor?
q2.answer: Free plan: 3 searches/month. Starter: 20 searches/month + 10 company watchlist. PRO: unlimited searches + 250 company watchlist. Enterprise: everything unlimited.

q3.question: How secure is my data?
q3.answer: We use bank-level encryption, GDPR compliance and store all data in EU data centers. Your watchlists and reports are never shared with third parties.

q4.question: Can I access the API?
q4.answer: API access is available for Enterprise plans. Contact our sales team to discuss integration options and custom requirements.

q5.question: What happens if I exceed my plan limits?
q5.answer: We'll notify you when you're approaching limits. You can upgrade anytime, or we'll pause additional searches until the next billing cycle. No surprise fees.

q6.question: How quickly will I receive alerts?
q6.answer: PRO and Enterprise plans receive real-time alerts within minutes of a filing or change. Starter plans get daily summary emails. Free plan includes basic email notifications.
